newsitem.title: USA: Stratosphere names Schuetz president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Stratosphere names Schuetz president, CEO.

text.p: Stratosphere Corp, operator of the Stratosphere hotel and casino, said on Thursday it named interim President Richard Schuetz as its full-time president and chief executive officer.

Schuetz replaces Lyle Berman in the chief executive's role. Berman remains chairman of Stratosphere. Berman is also chairman and chief executive of Grand Casinos Inc, which owns a 42-percent stake in Stratosphere.
Berman brought Schuetz onto Stratosphere's management team in July after several key executives resigned. Stratosphere has been ailing financially since it opened on April 30.
